verdict.rationale: Typesense's 'Building a search application' guide walks through creating a "books" collection, adding documents to it, and running searches with filtering and faceting. That is exactly the create, index, search flow in the story. Many install paths (Docker, Homebrew, binaries, packages) lower setup friction, and community comments describe it as simple and light to run. Missing for 10: any documented or hands-on evidence that the quickstart actually takes only minutes, and independent walkthroughs confirming the first-search experience.
